headline: US venture deal value hit a record $515.8 billion in the first nine months of 2026, but exits have not kept pace.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: a published data report, reported in full by SiliconANGLE.
importance_line: It matters for founders and investors because most of the market is not getting its money back through listings or sales, though the totals depend heavily on a few giant AI deals.
summary: SiliconANGLE reports, citing the PitchBook-NVCA Venture Monitor, that US venture deal value reached a record $515.8 billion in the first nine months of 2026, about 44% above the previous annual record, with much of it going to OpenAI and Anthropic. Exits lagged: SpaceX's $60 billion all-stock purchase of Cursor developer Anysphere made up 53.1% of third-quarter exit value, and Nizar Tarhuni, executive vice president of research and market intelligence at PitchBook, said the liquidity “won’t show up” for most of the market.
notes: SiliconANGLE read in full; the PitchBook-NVCA report itself was not read. Anthropic and OpenAI IPO details left out of this summary.
